# 3-minute pitch video — script (v2, Parallax 0.2.0, NVIDIA clusters)

Target: **2:45–2:55**. Record the screen at 1080p, voice-over after (re-recordable). No music, or music you have the licence for. No third-party logos on screen other than the product itself (NVIDIA's repos are public; showing their names is fine).

**A silent screen recording that follows this shot list is generated by `docs/hackathon/record-demo.mjs`** (Playwright, 1080p). Record your voice over it, or re-record by hand with the same steps.

**Before recording:** open the demo once so the machine is warm (the first request after a restart takes about a minute), check the model works (the Ask below returns "verified"), close notifications, pick light **or** dark theme and stay on it. Use the read-only link.

Demo: `https://marbled-river-9619.fly.dev/orgs/ws_cluster_a?token=<READ_ONLY_TOKEN>` (Cluster B: `/orgs/ws_cluster_b`).

---

### 0:00–0:20 — The problem (talk to camera or title card)
> "I just joined a team that builds on NVIDIA's agent stack. I don't know which repos matter, which services call which, or what breaks if I change something. Normally I'd spend two weeks asking people. Architects have the same problem at scale: a service mesh nobody fully understands. Parallax makes it navigable and, more important, verifiable."

*(Screen: the Cluster A map, repos only.)*

### 0:20–1:05 — Ask, and every claim is checked
> "I ask Parallax what I'm walking into."

Type: **"Which services consume the OpenShell gRPC gateway, and from which repos?"**
> "Nemotron, running on Nebius Token Factory, investigates with the code analysis engine's tools. It answers, and look at this: every relationship it claimed was checked by the engine. Verified. Supported. Unverifiable. The model doesn't decide what's true; the engine does."

Click **Show on map**.
> "And it takes me to exactly the part of the architecture that backs the answer."

### 1:05–1:40 — Explore, with how sure we are
*(Zoom out → open OpenShell → service → endpoints → Code → a file.)*
> "Repos, services, endpoints, then the code itself, loaded on demand."

*(Toggle **inferred** only, then **deterministic**.)*
> "Solid lines are proven by static analysis. Dashed lines are inferred, fainter the less sure the engine is. Parallax never promotes a guess to a fact."

*(Select an endpoint; inspector "Consumed by".)*
> "Click any endpoint: who consumes it, across repos, and how sure we are."

### 1:40–2:05 — Query: ask the graph directly
*(Click the **Query** toggle in the ask bar → "gRPC call sites into each service" → Run.)*
> "For people who want the raw graph: a read-only query page. Find, connect, group, sort, with the engine's count after every step. Here: every gRPC call site, bound to the service that provides it. No model involved; it's the engine's own answer."

### 2:05–2:30 — Coverage: what the engine could not see
*(Coverage → index health by repo, blind spots, the "not complete" reason.)*
> "And the honest part. For every repo: which analyses ran, what was skipped, and where the engine is blind. When it says coverage isn't complete, it says why. So 'no impact' is only claimed over code it could actually read."

### 2:30–2:50 — Web search, and how it's built
*(Ask: "According to the official gRPC documentation, what is server reflection, and which of our services would expose it?" → the answer cites grpc.io.)*
> "For general technical questions it searches the web through Tavily, official docs first, and what it read is checked like any other citation. Nemotron 3 Super plans, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning does the fast work, both through Nebius Token Factory, in a tool-calling loop with a hard budget. The demo runs on Fly."

### 2:50–3:00 — Close
> "Knowledge locked in people's heads, made navigable and verifiable. That's Parallax: if it's in your org's code, it can guide you."

*(End card: repo URL + demo URL.)*

---

### Real numbers you can quote (measured on the deployed demo, Lain 0.16.0)
- **Cluster A** (OpenShell, NemoClaw, NeMo-Fabric): 5 services, 203 endpoints, 52 dependencies.
- **Cluster B** (NeMo Agent Toolkit, UI, examples): 3 services, 27 endpoints, 2 dependencies.
- An Ask on the deployed demo takes about a minute (57 s measured for the web-search one).
- ~2,200 tests; every Ask's claims are re-checked by the engine.

### Keep it honest (do not say these)
- Do **not** say the app runs on Nebius AI Cloud: the model calls go to Nebius Token Factory; the demo is hosted on Fly.io.
- Do **not** claim a weekly digest across repos or team ownership ("which services belong to sales"); those are roadmap. Say "gRPC gateway" or another name-based concept.
- Cluster A's coverage is not complete (the engine says so on the Coverage page); say that, it is the point.
- The Query page has no natural-language "Translate" box yet.

### Shot list checklist
- [ ] Map zoomed out · [ ] Ask + verdicts + Show on map · [ ] drill repo→file · [ ] inferred vs deterministic · [ ] inspector "Consumed by" · [ ] Query → gRPC preset → Run · [ ] Coverage health + blind spots · [ ] web-search Ask citing grpc.io · [ ] end card with URLs
